conviction_note: No profit warning, no pre-release and no formal guide, so the Q3 numbers are new. The evidence is a slight positive lean built on proxies: Gothenburg peer Wallenstam reported positive Q3 property and derivative revaluations the day before, the sector is oversold, there is a buyback/asset-swap capital-return angle, and 5 of the last 6 reports rose. Against that, a known Ramboll termination risk and rising market rates could hit net lettings and the forward earnings capacity. So p_up is 56 on an abs move of 4.5 (above the name's observed ~2.8% median report-day move, because the hunters have measured too small), giving +0.54; the findings sum to +0.6 on their own scale and the two measurements agree.

already_public.what: Q3 lettings disclosed piecemeal: 2,600 sqm office in Gamlestaden (7 Jul) and 2,100 sqm in central Gothenburg, 'Samtliga nämnda uthyrningar gjordes under tredje kvartalet 2026' (13 Oct)

Current earnings capacity as at 1 July 2026 (the company's quasi-guide): rental income SEK 1,720m, operating surplus SEK 1,347m, income from property management SEK 790m, SEK 6.74/share; Sörred logistics acquisition (SEK 570m) completed 1 July; Ramboll intends to vacate Gårda (SEK 19m rental value, formal notice not yet received at Q2)
Port of Gothenburg combination deal: Platzer is a net seller of SEK 684m, completion at the earliest in Q4 2026 and subject to the municipal council

new_in_release.expect: Income from property management likely ~SEK 210-225m, ~1.80-1.90/share, against 198m / 1.65 in Q3 2025: up year on year from Sörred, buybacks and a seasonally light cost quarter. Mostly inside the company's own earnings capacity.
Net lettings: unknown sign. Q3 lettings were positive but small, and a formal Ramboll termination (SEK -19m) could make the quarter negative.

Unrealised derivative change positive (market rates rose over Q3, per Wallenstam's +578m); property value change roughly flat to slightly positive (Wallenstam +107m on ~73bn); NAV (EPRA NRV) flat to up from 133.

Updated earnings capacity as at 1 Oct: higher rental income from Sörred and lettings, with some pressure from financing cost as swaps roll at higher market rates. Roughly unchanged; no formal forecast is given.
Capital return: possible buyback update or extension (SEK ~103m remaining under the 200m programme; Pareto flags new buybacks after the Q4 asset swap). Positive if announced; unknown.

findings.finding: Gothenburg peer Wallenstam's Q3 report (15 Oct, 08:00) showed positive property revaluation (+107 MSEK) and a large derivative gain (+578 MSEK) for Jul-Sep. Read through, Platzer's Q3 should carry flat-to-positive values, a derivative gain on its SEK 11.35bn swap book and a firmer NAV, despite the sector's rate scare. Wallenstam traded about +2.2% on the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: Platzer took a SEK -125m unrealised property value hit and still rose 6.7% on the report day (2026-07-03), so the value line has not been the driver; IFPM and lettings have.
findings.original_quote: 1 juli–30 september 2026 ... Värdeförändring förvaltningsfastigheter uppgår till 107 Mkr (377). Värdeförändring finansiella instrument uppgår till 578 Mkr (159).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Platzer is up 0.8% intraday on 15 Oct and +2.3% since 13 Oct while Wallenstam is +2.2% today. If the read-through were fully in, Platzer would have closed the gap with its peer, but after an 11.6% one-month sector index fall it is still near its lows (61.9 vs 68.5 at end Q2).
findings.independence: Nordnet/Finwire 2026-10-09: the 10y rose from ~3.0% to 3.2-3.3% in September, which is what produces derivative gains (https://www.nordnet.se/blogg/billigt-racker-inte-fastighetssektorn-pressas)

findings.finding: Q3 income from property management should grow year on year against Q3 2025's SEK 198m / 1.65 per share: Q2 2026 was already SEK 212m / 1.80 (+6% per share), the SEK 570m Sörred logistics property was added on 1 July, and buybacks have reduced the share count.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this lands inside the company's own earnings capacity (6.74/share as at 1 July), and the analysts who model it have it. It is filed small because Q3 is seasonally the lightest cost quarter, which the capacity figure does not show.

findings.finding: Ramboll's planned exit from Gårda (SEK 19m annual rental value) was explicitly not yet booked in net lettings at Q2 because formal notice had not been received. If notice arrived in Q3 it lands as a negative net-lettings print, against only small disclosed Q3 lettings (2,600 + 2,100 sqm).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 net lettings were SEK -41m (Nordea termination) and the stock still rose 2.77%; Q2 2026's +34m coincided with +6.7%
findings.why_not_priced: The risk is disclosed but its timing is not. Q2's three-quarter streak of positive net lettings was the headline the stock rose on, so a negative Q3 would break that narrative. Already partly discounted: the Q3 2025 precedent shows the market looks through known terminations.

findings.finding: Capital-return optionality: SEK ~103m remains under the SEK 200m B-share buyback running to the 2027 AGM. Pareto (29 Sep) flags new buybacks after the Q4 Port of Gothenburg asset swap (Platzer a net seller of SEK 684m) as a catalyst, with the stock at about 51% discount to reported NAV, so the report or call may carry a buyback update.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 release day (17 Apr), when the buyback decision went out 15 minutes after the report: +2.64% against an index +2.05%
findings.original_quote: Pareto lyfter fortsatt operationell förbättring, ökad logistikexponering och möjligheten till nya aktieåterköp efter tillgångsbytet under fjärde kvartalet som potentiella katalysatorer.
findings.why_not_priced: No buyback progress has been disclosed since 30 June (no repurchase releases in the Nasdaq feed for Q3), and the stock has fallen 10% in 20 days, which is not consistent with the market pricing an expanded programme. Whether it comes in this release is uncertain, hence the low centre and wide upside.
findings.independence: Q2 report: 1,334,752 B shares repurchased for SEK 97m under the 200m authorisation (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aaad57f885e8374a06aed93bdc2547cb7)

findings.finding: Swedish market rates rose through September (10y from ~3.0% to 3.2-3.3%) and DNB Carnegie expects average debt costs to keep rising. Platzer's updated earnings capacity may therefore carry a higher financing cost as swaps are extended at higher rates; it disclosed extending SEK 1,250m of swaps in H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no clean precedent; the earnings capacity update has not been the measured driver
findings.original_quote: Tioårsräntan steg från drygt 3,0 procent i början av september till omkring 3,2-3,3 procent mot slutet av månaden. DNB Carnegie räknar med att den genomsnittliga skuldkostnaden fortsätter upp.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the sector index is -11.6% in a month and Platzer -10.4% in 20 days on this exact theme, and Pareto cut its target on it. Kept small because it is macro-to-company transmission, and the policy rate (and so STIBOR) was unchanged at 1.75% on 24 Sep.

outside_window.finding: Municipal council approval and Q4 completion of the Port of Gothenburg asset swap (net seller SEK 684m, rental income -35m), which frees capital for buybacks. Status unconfirmed.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, in line with the small positive run-up lean (+0.52 from a -10.4% 20-day fall). There is no short anchor to cut against, so the lean and the free control are the same object here.
